seven_dimensions.name: semantic_fidelity
seven_dimensions.description: Faithfulness of translation to source meaning, preserving all semantic content without omission, addition, or distortion
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Percentage of source semantic propositions correctly translated; penalizes omissions, additions, and mistranslations

seven_dimensions.name: literary_quality
seven_dimensions.description: Literary merit of the translation: flow, style, tone appropriateness, emotional resonance, and prose quality in target language
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Subjective literary evaluation: prose elegance, emotional impact, narrative voice consistency, stylistic appropriateness for genre

seven_dimensions.name: trad_chinese_quality
seven_dimensions.description: Quality of Traditional Chinese output: character correctness, grammar, idiomatic usage, register appropriateness, Taiwan/HK standard compliance
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Technical Chinese quality: character correctness (simplified vs traditional), grammar, idioms, register, punctuation, Taiwan usage norms

seven_dimensions.name: character_consistency
seven_dimensions.description: Consistency of character names, pronouns, titles, and references throughout the translation
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Percentage of character references that remain consistent; penalizes name variations, pronoun shifts, title inconsistencies

seven_dimensions.name: context_continuity
seven_dimensions.description: Maintenance of narrative context, temporal/spatial coherence, and cross-chunk coherence
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Cross-chunk coherence: temporal markers, spatial references, narrative flow, anaphora resolution, scene continuity

seven_dimensions.name: terminology_glossary
seven_dimensions.description: Adherence to provided glossary terms and consistent terminology usage
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Percentage of glossary terms correctly translated and consistently applied; penalizes missing glossary terms, inconsistent translations

seven_dimensions.name: structural_compliance
seven_dimensions.description: Adherence to output format requirements, chunk structure, formatting, and structural requirements
seven_dimensions.scoring_rule: Format compliance: paragraph structure, punctuation, formatting markers, output structure matching expectations

reconstruction_method: weights reverse-engineered from P3B overall=80.0 and dimension scores; assumes linear weighted average
rubric_source: P3B_MODEL_SCORECARD.json dimension scores reverse-engineered with weight estimation
note: Weights are estimates that produce P3B overall=80.0; actual P3B internal weights may differ slightly
